narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed across Middle Tennessee during the afternoon of May 2, 2025. With abundant instability and moisture and with the help of a front moving through the area, all the ingredients were present to allow for these thunderstorms to become severe. Several reports of large hail were received, especially near the Nashville metro area. The most significant damage was reported near Monterey were very strong winds caused tree and house damage.
ev: Heavy rain caused flash flooding along College Street in Pulaski. Extent of damages is unknown.
Heavy rain caused flash flooding along Tennessee State Road 98 near Second Creek Road in Loretto. Extent of damages is unknown.
lsr: Water completely covering College Street in Pulaski.
